description: React component 'InvoicesClient' for managing invoices in a shop, including listing, creating, and viewing invoices. Contains UI elements, form handling, data fetching via API client, and utility functions for formatting currency and dates.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number as a currency string with fallback to simple formatting if Intl.NumberFormat fails.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO string to a locale date string, or returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: toDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to a yyyy-mm-dd format for input fields.

methods.name: fromDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts a yyyy-mm-dd date string to an ISO string.

methods.name: statusVariant
methods.description: Maps invoice status to badge variant names.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the invoice creation form fields, checking for required fields and logical errors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating a new invoice, with optimistic UI update and API call.
